meta: When will AGI arrive? Top experts' answers are a decade apart. Why, what AI still lacks, and the skills that stay valuable either way.

muc.title: Guessing the year of AGI
muc.text: Ask top experts what year AGI will arrive, and their answers are a decade apart.

muc.title: People mean different things
muc.text: Partly because everyone means something different by AGI, and partly because AI is improving very fast, but unevenly.

muc.title: What AI still lacks
muc.text: AI today is still weak at three things: learning on its own after training, being reliably right for days in a row, and working in the real world.

muc.title: Skills that still count
muc.text: Whether AGI comes early or late, skills like asking the right questions, checking results and making decisions are still very valuable.

muc.title: Your task list
muc.text: List ten things you do in a week, mark the ones AI already helps with, then try giving AI one that isn't marked.
